description: PERFORM … UNTIL EXIT (ISO §2023:14.9.28.4 GR11) — a COBOL-2023 addition: an unconditional infinite loop (a condition that never becomes true). Plain UNTIL condition is edition-invariant; only the EXIT alternative is gated. Escape is by EXIT PERFORM (inline) or GOBACK/STOP RUN (out-of-line).
source:
IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
PROGRAM-ID. PUE.
DATA DIVISION.
WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
01 N PIC 9 VALUE 0.
PROCEDURE DIVISION.
MAIN.
    PERFORM UNTIL EXIT
        ADD 1 TO N
        IF N = 2 EXIT PERFORM END-IF
    END-PERFORM.
    STOP RUN.
